goal: Stop redundant systemd enable/disable reloads in routine guardian reconciliation while preserving exact protection policy and fresh receipts.
context: Follow-up to deployed a41047c. Guardian artifacts now correctly packaged and >20 nodes applied. Remaining panel alerts include genuine CPU/conntrack protection. Read-only native pinned-SSH OS probe found systemd lifetime CPU 25-49 percent on several affected small hosts while guardian process uses 0.6-2 percent; this does not yet prove causality. Source installCommand issues systemctl enable --now on every normal controller reconciliation. Official systemd documentation/source confirms enable implicitly reloads daemon configuration. Add idempotent enabled/disabled state handling: avoid enable when already persistently enabled and avoid disable when already disabled; still start/stop as required, reload for changed owned unit, restart only for staged binary or changed unit, retain policy revision fence, ownership/symlink guards, exact hash, allowlist and status validation. Do not relax CPU/conntrack thresholds, admission checks, client limits, native checkpoints or readiness. Test generated service transition shell with isolated fake systemctl: repeated healthy reconcile no enable/reload, disabled->enabled and stopped->running recover, enabled->disabled stop and cleanup ordering, command failure propagates. Test is-enabled state parsing must not mistake enabled-runtime for persistent enabled; uncertain state fails safely through real necessary operation. Keep network direct, no new proxy usage. Full Go and relevant race, actual exact-source API review, real guardian packaging gate, checkpoint/push/clean coordinated deploy. Before test/commit fast-forward this isolated worktree to the independently reviewed account-purge-artifacts follow-up when complete so changes compose; no modifications to that work. No production fault injection or account deletion, no subagents. After deploy compare same-node systemd cumulative CPU over bounded interval and native panel receipts, report real resource pressure honestly rather than hiding alerts. Pending 90-percent proxy target requires comparable actual measured bytes, not fabricated savings.
commit_message: fix(protection): avoid repeated systemd reloads during reconciliation
